name: Bhuna Gosht
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red chili powder (adjust to taste)
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, cardamoms, cloves, and cinnamon; sizzle for 30 seconds. 2. Add sliced onions and sauté until deep golden brown (15-20 minutes), stirring occasionally. 3. Add ginger and garlic; cook for 2 minutes until fragrant. 4. Add lamb cubes and sear on all sides until browned (about 5-7 minutes). 5. Stir in turmeric, coriander, red chili, and salt; cook for 2 minutes. 6. Reduce heat to low, add yogurt slowly while stirring continuously to avoid curdling. 7. Cover and cook on very low heat for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lamb is tender and oil separates. 8. Uncover, increase heat to reduce excess liquid if needed, then garnish with cilantro.
description: A slow-cooked symphony of caramelized onions, tender lamb, and warm spices, echoing the rustic kitchens of Punjab.
